notes: In Thai, family terms are very specific about relative age. 'น้อง' (nóng) is used for any sibling younger than the speaker, regardless of gender.
Adding 'ชาย' (chaai) specifies that the person is male. If the sibling were female, you would use 'น้องสาว' (nóng săao).
